# Northwind Interview Pack
> [!tip] They want a builder who is technically credible and business-led.

## What Each Interviewer Is Listening For

### Chief Data Officer — Hiring Manager

- People-first leadership and business embedding.
- Pragmatic quick wins that create demand for more.

### Director, Data & ML Products — Peer

- Technical credibility on the existing platform.
- Clear boundaries between the AI function and ML platform work.

-----

## Question 1 — Opening (CDO)

**"Tell us about yourself and why this role."**

### What They Want to Hear

- A concise, structured answer under 90 seconds.
- Concrete outcomes drawn from the evidence bank.

### Model Answer

"I build AI functions in regulated financial services and ship governed systems into production."

## Question 2 — 90-Day Plan (Peer)

### What They Want to Hear

- Listening before building; a use-case register by day 30.
- An evaluation framework defined before anything ships.
